NameValue.description: A customer-facing value with a required base fallback and optional exact locale overrides. Locale tags must use their canonical BCP 47 spelling.

id.description: Optional stable metadata identifier; consumers must not render it as display copy.

locales.description: Canonical BCP 47 locales for which the base value was authored.

value.description: Required base value returned when no exact locale override exists.

values.description: Exact canonical BCP 47 locale tags mapped to localized overrides.

ProviderDeprecation.description: Coherent metadata for a deprecated provider entry. Presence of this object means the provider is deprecated. replacementProviderId, when present, must name a different canonical provider in the same catalog; it cannot identify the deprecated provider itself.

deprecatedSince.description: UTC calendar date on which the catalog began marking the provider deprecated.

reason.description: Localizable explanation of why the provider is deprecated.

replacementProviderId.description: Canonical ID of a different, non-deprecated replacement provider in this catalog.

ProviderDiscoveryEndpointKind.description: Static endpoint transport kind that may be checked without credentials.

ProviderDiscoveryPrerequisite.description: Sanitized prerequisite guidance that never carries a secret or machine-local value.

description.description: Bounded setup guidance without environment values or paths.

name.description: Stable prerequisite name, never a secret value.

ProviderDiscoveryPrerequisites.description: Static, credential-free facts that tooling may use to explain how a provider can be discovered. Only names and endpoint kinds are published: credential values, environment values, endpoint addresses, machine-local paths, installation/readiness state, and pricing are outside this contract.

configurationKeys.description: Required configuration-key names only; configuration and environment values are forbidden.

endpointKinds.description: Credential-free endpoint transport kinds; addresses and live status are not published.

executableNames.description: Executable basenames that may supply the provider integration.

prerequisites.description: Sanitized executable, authentication, workspace, or configuration requirements.

ProviderDocumentationLink.description: One stable public documentation resource for a provider.

url.description: Public HTTPS documentation URL with a DNS hostname. Machine-local, IP-address, and credential-bearing URLs are invalid.

ProviderDocumentationLinkKind.description: Purpose of one stable public provider documentation link.

ProviderEffort.description: Provider-supported reasoning effort setting for one model.

ProviderExecutionCapabilities.description: Maximum evidenced execution features of the provider integration. These values are independent of support posture and do not imply current-machine readiness.

imageInput.description: Accepts image content as invocation input.

promptSubmission.description: Accepts authored prompt input for execution.

sessionResume.description: Can continue an identified provider session.

structuredOutput.description: Can constrain authoritative output using a structured schema.

toolExecution.description: Can execute provider-managed tools during an invocation.

workingDirectory.description: Can execute with an explicit working directory.

worktree.description: Can execute against an isolated source-control worktree.

ProviderImplementationAvailability.description: How an implementation is supplied. Availability is publication metadata, not a live readiness or installation result.

ProviderKnownLimit.description: Named bounded provider constraint or documented behavior.

default.description: Positive numeric default when kind is default.

description.description: Bounded operator-facing explanation of the limit.

maximum.description: Positive numeric maximum when kind is maximum.

unit.description: Unit or flag domain for the value.

value.description: Bounded non-numeric behavior value when kind is behavior.

ProviderKnownLimitKind.description: Meaning of the value recorded by one named provider limit fact.

ProviderManifest.description: Public, data-only metadata for one model-provider integration. A manifest describes evidenced maximum behavior and publication posture; it never reports current-machine installation, authentication, readiness, pricing, or runtime registration.

aliases.description: Alternate lowercase identifiers; aliases must not equal or shadow any catalog ID or alias.

documentation.description: Stable public documentation links for this provider.

knownLimits.description: Named provider constraints and bounded behavior facts in canonical name order.

models.description: Named provider models and their complete capability facts in canonical model-ID order.

tools.description: Named provider tool facts in canonical tool-name order.

ProviderModality.description: One explicit supported or unsupported directional modality fact.

ProviderModalityDirection.description: Direction in which a provider model accepts or emits a modality.

ProviderModalityKind.description: Media or content modality understood by a provider model.

ProviderModalitySupport.description: Whether the provider model supports the modality in this direction.

ProviderModalityTransport.description: How a supported modality is supplied or returned.

ProviderModel.description: Capability facts for one named model exposed by a provider.

efforts.description: Reasoning effort values accepted independently by this model.

id.description: Exact model identifier accepted by the provider adapter.

modalities.description: Complete directional modality facts, including unsupported values.

ProviderResponseFidelityCapabilities.description: Maximum evidenced response-event fidelity of the provider integration. Capabilities describe observable output independently of support posture.

providerReconnect.description: Supports reconnecting an interrupted provider response stream.

reasoningSummaries.description: Emits reasoning summaries or reasoning deltas.

stableItemIds.description: Assigns stable item identifiers across response events.

ProviderTechnicalSupportLevel.description: Maintainer-verified technical support posture for a provider integration. This value does not describe whether the provider is installed or ready on the current machine.

ProviderTool.description: One named provider tool fact used for execution planning.

description.description: Bounded explanation of the tool fact.

ProviderToolSupport.description: Whether the provider exposes a named tool through its integration.

description: Versioned public collection of provider manifests.

providerSchema.description: Immutable JSON Schema identifier used to validate every provider entry.

providers.description: Provider manifests in canonical provider-ID order.

publicationProvenance.description: Optional source-revision provenance supplied by a publication staging process.

sourceCommit.description: Full immutable Git commit identifying the published source tree.

sourceRepository.description: Public source repository from which the catalog was published.
